decisions.reason: This LED track spotlight sits close to the core range and kept its own page in both years, so it is cheap to carry and its value is still being realized in the modular system.
This ceiling luminaire is close to the established offer and was steadily presented in 2023 and 2024, so a low carrying cost and an unresolved upside favor keeping it.
Launched in 2024 and presented on its own page, this spotlight's prospects are still uncertain and it costs little to keep within the existing system.
The multi-outlet canopy builds on the modular system, so it adds option value to the established luminaires at modest cost while its demand is still unresolved.
The low-voltage canopy extends the system's flexibility and is too new for its uncertainty to have resolved, so the option is worth more than its carrying cost.
It was only mentioned rather than given its own page, which signals weaker commitment within a broad portfolio, but as a 2024 launch close to the core it is still cheap to keep while uncertain.
